lines.text: Many learners say: Our mother is a nurse.
Better: My mother is a nurse.
Use my for your own family.
My! My mother is a nurse.

data.why: Use my for your own family.

native.tip: ‘우리 엄마’의 ‘우리’를 our로 옮기기 쉬워요. 내 가족은 my! 이렇게 말해요 👉 “My mother is a nurse.”
native.caption: “Our mother is a nurse”처럼 말하고 있나요? 😅 한국어는 내 엄마도 ‘우리 엄마’라고 하지만, 영어에서는 나 혼자의 가족을 말할 때 my를 써요. 맞는 문장 ✅ “My mother is a nurse.” Carlos 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.

en.tip: Use my for your own mother. Say “My mother is a nurse.”
en.caption: Do you say “Our mother is a nurse” in English? 😅 In Korean you may say our mother, but in English you say my for your own family! “My mother is a nurse” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
